Section(s): Appendix A. List of model equations (Kontoravdi et al., 2005)

Text and equations in reading order:
    The mass balances on the viable and total cell populations, based on conventional assumptions such as perfect mixing and negligible dilution effect, are
(1) \frac{d V}{d t}=F_{i n}-F_{o u t}    [code: ODE, computes V, code proposes balance]
(2) \frac{d(V X_{\nu})}{d t}=\mu V X_{\nu}-\mu_{d}V X_{\nu}-F_{o u t}X_{\nu}    [code: ODE, computes X_{\nu}, code proposes balance]
(3) \frac{d(V X_{t})}{d t}=\mu V X_{\nu}-F_{o u t}X_{t}    [code: ODE, computes X_{t}, code proposes balance]
    The specific cell growth rate is determined by the concentrations of the glucose, glutamine, lactate and ammonia, following Monod kinetics:
(4) \mu=\mu_{m a x}f_{l i m}f_{i n h}    [code: algebraic, computes \mu, code proposes constitutive]
(5) f_{l i m}=\left(\frac{[G L C]}{K_{g l c}+[G L C]}\right)\left(\frac{[G L C]}{K_{g l n}+[G L C]}\right)    [code: algebraic, computes f_{lim}, code proposes constitutive]
(6) f_{i n h}=\left(\frac{K_{I l a c}}{K_{I l a c}+[L A C]}\right)\left(\frac{K_{I a m m}}{K_{I a m m}+[A M M]}\right)    [code: algebraic, computes f_{inh}, code proposes constitutive]
    Based on the assumption that cell death only depends on the concentration of ammonia in the extracellular medium, the rate of cell death is determined by
(7) \mu_{d}=\frac{\mu_{d,m a x}}{1+(K_{d,a m m}/[A M M])^{n}},\quad n>1    [code: algebraic, computes \mu_{d}, code proposes constitutive]
    The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
(8) \frac{d(V[G L C])}{d t}=-Q_{g l c}V X_{\nu}+F_{i n}[G L C]_{i n}-F_{o u t}[G L C]    [code: ODE, computes [GLC], code proposes balance]

Symbols:
  V: Reactor liquid volume [L] (computed)
  F_{in}: Inlet volumetric flow rate into the bioreactor [L h^-1] (variable)
  F_{out}: Outlet volumetric flow rate from the bioreactor [L h^-1] (variable)
  X_{\nu}: Viable cell concentration (viable cell density) [cells L^-1] (computed)
  \mu: Specific viable cell growth rate [h^-1] (computed)
  \mu_{d}: Specific cell death rate [h^-1] (computed)
  X_{t}: Total cell concentration (viable + dead) [cells L^-1] (computed)
  \mu_{max}: Maximum specific growth rate [h^-1] (parameter)
  f_{lim}: Limiting factor term for growth (product of Monod saturation functions) [-] (computed)
  f_{inh}: Inhibition factor term for growth (product of inhibition functions) [-] (computed)
  [GLC]: Extracellular glucose concentration [mM] (computed)
  K_{glc}: Monod constant for glucose [mM] (parameter)
  K_{gln}: Monod constant for glutamine [mM] (parameter)
  K_{Ilac}: Monod constant for lactate [mM] (parameter)
  [LAC]: Extracellular lactate concentration [mM] (computed)
  K_{Iamm}: Monod constant for ammonia [mM] (parameter)
  [AMM]: Extracellular ammonia concentration [mM] (computed)
  \mu_{d,max}: Maximum specific death rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{d,amm}: Ammonia constant for cell death [mM] (parameter)
  n: Hill coefficient in death rate expression (n > 1) [-] (parameter)
  Q_{glc}: specific glucose consumption rate per cell mass [mmol g^{-1} h^{-1}] (computed)
  [GLC]_{in}: glucose concentration in the inlet feed [mmol L^{-1}] (variable)
